author: @marit4241
text: I  am not what you would say "a carat" but for these recent generations of K-Pop I follow SVT about some years now, and these days I kept watching some compilation videos of them, so I would like to share a opinion. As a K-Pop follower since 2010, (when I became an Elf and turned out studying at college about K-Pop and how it's consumed, about 8 years ago) I can say SVT surprises me everytime I watch them. Even if seems like they are not well known here in Americas (I am from South America), if we can say it (you Carats will know better), I see them like a jewel. As someone here said, they are making their own path and it surprises me because it is not easy to see something like this. Before, people were not allowed to express like this in Kpop or even produce, and if they did, could be only a member or two, and now many groups, specially smaller agencies, still keep the traditional system based in hard work and popularity only. Sometimes I see many hype about some famous groups, but people are not always thinking about quality, they are considering numbers and how they are famous. And I am sorry for saying that but celebrities are made, if some media likes you and realizes your fame can return money to them, they will invest on you. That's why many people now are not really k-pop fans, they are fans of a specific group or even a specific song. But they count in media and numbers because they buy products. Maybe it's a question of generation, I don't know and I am not judging, what I am tryint to say is that SVT or their fandom should not feel like "oh nobody talks about us" or "we don't achieve this or that prize". That's nice, and of course matters to the emprise, but the real thing that matters is quality always, this is the only thing who stays. Fame goes aways (i am not foreshadowing about groups, it's just a fact based in many groups I have liked, even not k-pop). SVT I see as a group on their own. As Suju got to a high level in K-Pop now, not worrying about what to sell and always being remembered, as we are seeing with Big Bang these days too, to me SVT is almost the same, although they don't have 10 years of debut. They produce their own content and music, seem like they have liberty to make stuff and when you see them they all seem like being themselves. This is not reached easily when you have to respond and make a image that a company wants to show about you or if you are so famous that you can't express your own because you have to seem perfect all the time. For example, if a foreign member would be like The8, so sincere for what I saw, years ago, maybe he would be got out of the group. Now things have changed, culture have changed and people are more conected than older generations in K-Pop were (for those who does not know, good internet and social media were created/achieved in some countries here about 2010 or 2012, and became more popular and acessible on next years, so those who knew Suju, Shinee, DBSK, SNSD, 2nE1 were a really few people, that's why today is really "easy" to achieve millions and older groups does not have those views or is achieving it now). So numbers now are a thing indeed, but always remember quality. As another person said here, they are artists not celebrities. And I believe that too, that's why I keep going back to their videos/tv shows. Of course, if you are reading this you know I am older, not a super deeper follower of groups anymore  (age makes you worries about other things, so don't worry if this happens to you someday) , but I have seen many groups of quality disbanding and chaning for all those years, including one of my favorites, Boyfriend. Lack of promotion, money, fans...Everything in K-Pop can make you disband, it's a high risk industry. But for SVT, they seem like a group who will last for a long time if they continue like this. Is it because everything they do is high quality, from music to entertainment? Is it because Pledis has 13 talented members so they don't need to worry and just have to let them go like this? Could be too, but you feel them, from the bottom of the heart, not just working hard, but doing it naturally, bc they like it. So don't care just about numbers, care about the quality they always shares, because someday soon people will know them and got surprised about what SVT is .

text:
Seventeen music recommendations:

💎Left and right💎
*Moodboosting song that made u feel good* : Good to me, a-teen, let me hear you say, rocket, fast pace
*Chill with more hip-hop* : Change up, check in, what's good, chili
*chill but make u wanna dance* :    moonwalkee, network love, shhh

💎Don't wanna cry💎
*songs to listen on rainy day* : if I, second life, fallin flower, Trauma, lie again, without you, run to you 
*sad songs*: thanks, habit, hug, can't see the end, don't listen in secret, pinwheel, smile flower

💎Pretty you💎
*softer heart fluttering songs*: 20, fallin for you, hello, drift away, when I grow up, healing, still lonely 
*nostalgic songs that feel like ure watching sunset* : mymy, holiday, simple, together, HITORI JANAI, campfire, love letter

💎Home💎
*Comforting songs* : kidult, say yes, I don't know, our dawn is hotter than day, popular song, I wish
*calming songs* : 247, my I, lean on me, come to me 

💎Fear💎
*Dark songs* : Fearless, flower, bring it, getting closer 
*Dark with more hip-hop* : Un Haeng II chi, back it up,  ah yeah, lotto 
*Less dark but makes u feel yourself* : Lilili yabbay, crazy in love, highlight, fronting , NO F.U.N, OMG, chuck, jam jam

💎Clap💎
*Energetic hype songs that makes u wanna scream* : call call call, hit, rock, just do it, Aju nice, mansae, boom boom
*Less energetic but still upbeat*: 9-teen, happy ending, thinkin about you, Shining diamond 

💎oh my💎
*Bubbly songs that makes u wanna smile* : beautiful, lucky, snapshoot, swimming fool, adore you 

💎home run💎
- Doremi (upbeat, fun, light) 
- hey buddy (swing/retro tunes) 
- light a flame (sexy, groovy)
- ah love (upbeat, dance, EDM, chill) 
- all my love (upbeat, chill, sentimental) 

Trust me all their b-sides tracks and Japanese tracks are masterpiece. They have many genres of music including cool, anime vibes, cute and fresh, sentimental, musical, kinda rock, sexy,asthetic, kingsman vibes etc... Although if u didn't like some songs, you can't deny that there is no bad songs at all. It's just differ based on our own preference. Seventeen have one of the flawless music discography in kpop so give it a try! Woozi is indeed a music genius, he not only can produce, compose songs and write beautiful lyrics but also can sing like main vocal, dance and choreographed well, play many instruments including drums, guitar, clarinet, flute, piano etc.. text:
for those who's thinking 

*"Why should I vote on MAMA when it's obvious who will win?"*

Here's the logical answer:
It's bcos votes only account to 20%-30% of the final winner criteria. In AOTY % BMG, 30% is also determined by judges panel, and the rest are from digital and album sales, which I can say, is definitely not a little, especially since we became a triple million seller. In SOTY & Best Dance Performance, the percentage of judges panel is even bigger: 40%! 

This means we still have a chance, a large chance in my opinion, to win any of those awards. That is, if we can *close the gap* between votes, vote properly, diligently everyday! *Isn't it such a waste if the judges give svt favorable scores compared to others, but we lose because our votes gap is too big??*

And also there's a specia prize (best music video) where 70% of the criteria comes from the judges panel. The rest? Global mv vi3ws. That's why we need to str17m everytime we have nothing to do. 

Another thing I want to add, for APAN Best Group for Man, 100% of the votes will be reflected on the award, and we're currently no. 1!!! I'm very proud of this and if we all could work together and prevent other groups from stealing the lead, I'm sure we can add another trophy to seventeen's wall of fame! 

This is what I think and I hope this can encourage you all in voting and str17ming because I really want to see svt getting the recognition (and awards) they deserve!!

6. if the mv is played as a PAID ADVERTISEMENT, just watch it as well because the vi3w  will be counted.

text:
SEVENTEEN/ SVT (세븐틴) adalah boy grup asal Korea Selatan bentukan Pledis Entertainment. Mereka terdiri dari S.coups, Junghan, Joshua, Jun, Hoshi, Wonwoo, Woozi, DK, Mingyu, The8, Seungkwan, Vernon, Dino. Seventeen juga di bagi dalam 3 unit yaitu Vocal Team, Hip Hop Team dan Performence Team. Nama Seventeen juga bisa di artikan seperti ini: 13 anggota + 3 sub-unit + 1 grup = 17 (Seventeen).

￼￼

 

Seventeen memulai debutnya pada tanggal 26 Mei 2015 dengan lagu “Adore U” dipanggung MBC Music. Lagu tersebut merupakan lead track dari album mini pertama Seventeen berjudul ‘17 Cara’t yang baru resmi diluncurkan pada tanggal 29 Mei. Sukses dengan debutnya, Seventeen mengeluarkan album mini keduanya bertajuk ‘Boys Be’ pada tanggal 10 September 2015. Merekapun promosi lagu andalanya yaitu “Mansae” di program-program musik mingguan. Meski baru debut, Seventeen sudah mendapat beberapa penghargaan, seperti di Golden Disk Awards, Seoul Music Awards dan Gaon K-Pop Chart Awards. Selain itu juga, Seventeen merupakan satu-satunya grup k-pop yang masuk daftar di Billboard “21 Under 21 2015”.

￼￼

Setelah menggelar konser solonya bertajuk “Like Seventeen – Boys Wish” pada bulan Februari 2016 lalu, mereka langsung menetapkan nama fandomnya, yaitu CARAT. Mereka juga mengumumkan kalau akan segera comeback dengan album pertama. Setelah persiapan matang, akhirnya Seventeen comeback dengan lagu “Pretty U” dari album perdananya ‘Love & Letter’ yang resmi dirilis pada tanggal 25 April 2016. Sejak debut pada bulan Mei 2015 lalu, akhirnya Seventeen meraih trofi pertamanya dipanggung Show Champion pada tanggal 4 Mei 2016 dengan lagu “Pretty U”. Kemudian, mereka merilis album repackage dari album sebelumnya, dengan judul ‘Love & Letter Repackage Album’ pada 4 Juli 2016. Di album repackage ini terdapat tambahan 5 buah lagu yaitu NO. F.U.N, Healing, Simple, Can’t See The End, dan Very Nice dipilih sebagai lead tracknya. Menutup tahun 2016, Seventeen comeback dengan lagu “Boom Boom” yang merupakan bagian dari album mini ketiganya ‘Going Seventeen’ yang dirilis pada tanggal 5 Desember.

Pada tanggal 22 Mei 2017, Seventeen akhirnya comeback dengan lagu “Don’t Wanna Cry”. Lagu tersebut merupakan bagian dari album mini keempat mereka berjudul ‘Al1’. Usai promosi lagu barunya, Seventeen melanjutkan kegiatanya dengan menggelar tur dunia pertama mereka bertajuk “Diamond Edge”. Pada tanggal 6 November 2017, Seventeen comeback dengan album lagu baru berjudul ‘Clap. Lagu tersebua merupakan lead singel dari album kedua Seventeen berjudul “TEEN, AGE”.

￼￼

hello new carats! welcome to the diamond life, here's a bit of a guide for the members in the video. (I'll list em in the official order). -
2. Jeonghan (0:35), (1:03), (2:22). Yoon Jeonghan. Vocal Unit, Lead Vocalist. Korean, 95 line, 2nd to the oldest. Has an angel image, visuals and voice, but deep in his heart he is actually evil and a manipulator that we all love.
-
3. Joshua (0:42) (2:06) (2:42). Joshua Hong/Hong Jisoo. Vocal Unit, Lead Vocalist, Visual. Korean-American. 95 line, maknae of 95 line. That uncle from LA, when he raps it's the end of hip-hop unit's career, CEO of Sunday Morning by Maroon 5.
-
4. Jun (0:58) (1:55). Moon Junhui/Wen Junhui. Performance Unit, Lead Dancer, Sub-Vocalist. China, 96 line. Considered a visual, reminds everyone he is made in China, likes lemons, a copycat, and fake maknae.
-
5. Hoshi (1:08) (2:54). Kwon Soonyoung. Performance Unit Leader, Main Dancer, Lead Vocalist, Sub-Rapper. Korean, 96 line.  One of SVT's main choreographers. Thinks he is a tiger, acts like he is a tiger, talks like he is a tiger, but is actually human not a tiger.
-
6. Wonwoo (1:39). Jeon Wonwoo. Hip Hop Unit, Lead Rapper, Sub-Vocalist. Korean, 96 line. Has a voice deeper than the pacific ocean, looks cold and rude but actually just has bad eyesight.
-
7. Woozi (1:19) (3:04). Lee Jihoon. Vocal Unit, Lead Vocalist. SVT's main producer. Korean, maknae of 96 line. smol, short but can kill you deadly. Likes to sleep because he works 24/7 on the studio. Bruno Mars' number 1 fanboy.
-
8. The8 (0:37) (2:12). Seo Myungho/ Xu Minghao. Performance Team, Lead Dancer, Sub-Vocalist, Sub-Rapper. Chinese, actually the maknae of 97 line but he wanted number 8 (in the official counting numbers) so he exchanged with DK. Invented art, and art in dancing. Either soft or savage, take a pick. Actually don't, he picks em for you.

9. Mingyu (0:31), (1:06) (1:46). Kim Mingyu. Hip Hop Unit, Lead Rapper, Sub-Vocalist, Main Visual, Face of the Group. Korean, tallest member. Can do everything, even things your mom does (cooking, cleaning, planting, etc). Is 6'2 but likes to act like 4'2.

10. DK (0:27) (1:13) (2:16) (3:09). Lee Seokmin. Vocal Unit, Main Vocalist. Korean, 97 line. King Arthur, our musical actor. The loudest member, and our brightest happy virus. His smile is brighter than all of our futures combined. He is crazy.. for food.

11. Seungkwan (1:24) (3:00). Boo Seungkwan. Vocal Unit,  Main Vocalist, Face of the Group. Korean, 98 line. An iconic diva, and a legend vocalist. Won the rookie entertainer award, but he is a singer okay, not a comedian. Cute and kind boy, from JEJU.

12. Vernon (0:47) (2:37). Hansol Vernon Chwe/Choi Hansol. Hip Hop Unit, Main Rapper, Sub Vocalist, Visual, Face of the Group. Korean-American, 98 line. A living, breathing meme legend. He is mood from head to toe. A talented lyricist.

13. Dino (2:01) (2:33). Lee Chan. Performance Unit, Main Dancer, Sub-Vocalist, Sub-Rapper, Maknae. Korean, 99 line. Seventeen's very own little giant maknae. Talented. Very. Likes to roasts his hyung, has no shame in that because he learned it from them.

9. Mingyu: The man who can do everything, sings, dances, raps, cooks, draws, designs and does housework, tall, handsome, sweet but he is a bit silly ...

12. Vernon: The copy of Leonardo D'caprio, an American who feels more Korean, has a very unique style, good rapper and a walking meme, for their gestures and reactions.

author: @Orinoka666
text:
Hello! Thank you for appreciating our boys. Here's some additional information:
-they're a self-producing group, means they write, compose, produce, and choreograph (because their company was too broke to help them and delayed their debut for 2 years, they decided to do everything by themselves and not rely on the company, they basically saved pledis from going bankrupt)
- name of the group explained: 13 members + 3 units + 1 team = 17
- they're divided into 3 units: hip-hop unit, vocal unit, performance unit
- Woozi is their main producer, lyricist, and composer, but every member participated in writing and composing at least once
- hip-hop unit writes their own rap parts
- performance unit is creating choreographies
- there's a special sub-unit BSS - BooSeokSoon which consists of 3 the funniest members, making them a gag trio (DK, Hoshi, Seungkwan)

author: @Orinoka666
text:
Today's a year since I became a Carat 😭 I became interested in them after MAMA 2017. I didn't search them right away, but the small voice in the back of my head was constantly reminding me of it. The first song that popped up was Clap. I didn't remember their performance that much so it was like a new experience. That little sketch at the beginning instantly got my attention. I usually skip those but this time I didn't want to. When I heard the music, oh boy, that's when it happened. The moment I heard that electric guitar I knew I was going to love it, I couldn't wait to listen to the whole song. Maybe because besides k-pop I listen to alternative rock music 😂 Anyway. The music video kept my attention the whole time. I was a little overwhelmed by 13 members (I remember counting them and somehow I counted 12, not 13 ahshsh I'm dumb) but I was determined to know their names. "I only want to know their names" yeah that's how it started 😂 I remember seeing comments about how the mv was cheap etc. and I was shocked because I loved it, it was funny to watch, the colors matched so well and overall it was pleasant to watch. I'm very thankful to that person who did time stamps with names for me when I asked who is who 😭 I don't remember their username and I can't find this comment but thank you, nice person 😭 

I remember looking up Seventeen's profiles and thinking "damn, there are 3 guys my age and the rest is younger than me" which made me a little disappointed at first 😭 But then I found out that the shortest member is still taller than me so I didn't mind 😂 I learned their names and faces by watching OFD season 1. I wasn't really focusing on recognizing them tho because the show was too funny. For some reason, I was mistaking Woozi and The8 😂 I think I've seen this show about 10 times now, maybe more. Their 2nd song I heard was Boom Boom and I'm still triggered when somebody calls it a flop because I loved it. 

But let me tell you guys something. I wouldn't have become more interested in them if I didn't like their personalities. I've been into kpop for so long, I've seen lots of groups and it's not that easy to impress me anymore but I guess Seventeen had this charm in them. It was like we instantly clicked 😂 I used to be an YG stan and YG's groups have this badass vibe so Seventeen's music was very different and I was kind of surprised I liked it so much. For a long time, I was convinced that I prefer groups with a more "strong" image like Monsta X but it turned out differently 😂 Maybe my preferences changed because I also changed. 

I've said this before but Seventeen's music is very special to me. I'm an introvert and a highly sensitive person with social anxiety. Their music has a calming effect on me and helps me to cope in everyday life. They're such kings of positive vibes. The only thing I can do for them as a "thank you" is supporting them as much as I can. I'm thankful for the opportunity of being able to enjoy their music ♥

text:
Proper streaming for YouTube views


1) Watch the video all the way through, from the first to the last second!  


2) Watch the video in HD (720p, at least)!  Youtube logic is that views only count if they are more pretty. 


3) DON’T skip, stop or rewind the video, because that won’t count as a view.


4) The sound on your phone should be more then 50%, you can use earphones, but the sound should stay more then 50%!  You can mute the sound on your laptop and PC, but be sure that the volume on the Youtube page is more then 50%


5) Before rewatching the same video you should delete the watching and searching history because YouTube totally monitors those things because they care a lot about persecuting you if you are a “true fan” 

6) LOG OUT after the first watching of the video because from one account you can watch the same video ONLY ONCE in an hour!  But if you have a few accounts then you can delete the whole history after watching the video, log out from one account and log in another one, then repeat.  This will fool YouTube’s spam filter so they don’t take away your precious views.


7) Don’t forget to leave comments and likes, which is called “engagement” and that makes your views more meaningful because people tend to leave comments on videos the first time they look at them.  This fools YouTube into thinking that you are a normal person with a life instead of thinking you’re a bot.


8) STREAM MANUALLY! Don’t use playlists and loops as they are the main reason that YouTube freezes the view count for a long time, also not all of views from them will be counted by YouTube system, only 10-30%!  


9) DON’T USE multiple tabs or incognito mode – they are counted as SPAM and your views will be deleted for sure!  

10) Don’t replay the video or refresh the page for rewatching – your views will be counted as SPAM and will be deleted for sure!  It’s always important to do things the long and inconvenient way instead!  


11) DON’T SKIP THE ADS!  They are counted as part of the video because YouTube needs to make their money and if you skip them your views will not counted by Youtube.  Also obviously don’t use an adblocker.  


12) Don’t change the speed of the video


13) Use different browsers (Mozilla Firefox, Opera, Google Chrome and etc), accounts, internet connections (Wi-Fi and mobile data), devices (PC, TV, phone, laptop) for streaming of the videos – these things will help to increase the views!


14) Comment, like and share the video on social media

author: @Orinoka666
text: This may sound a bit cliche but no other group has ever made me feel the way I feel about Seventeen. I'm saying this as a k-pop fan since 2009. 2nd gen groups will always have a special place in my heart and I respect them a lot. I like several k-pop boy groups and girl groups, I listen to their music, sometimes I watch shows with them but it's just not the same. I'm just not interested in them that much to spend my time on them. That's the reason I will never consider myself being a multi-fan. There's nothing wrong with being multifandom, it's just not for me. It took me 8 years to find a k-pop group I'd love so much. It made me realize that not only music is important. Idols' personality is a huge factor in becoming a fan. I've been a carat for almost a year. Sometimes I regret not discovering them sooner, but I'm glad for having the opportunity of being a part of the fandom regardless ♥

author: @dianamontoya6895
text: proud carat right here. To me the same thing happens to me. I started listening to several groups, like ftisland, or BAP, thanks to my best friend, I was able to enter KPOP. I even liked BTS a lot, before RUN, but since SVT debuted, I feel that I found that group that with its songs tells me many things, beyond its lyrics. I think that more than anything is his subliminal message, I think that SVT is really a group that wants to give optimism and bring joy of life. I have been a very depressed person and I feel the need for someone to listen to me. In real life I have friends and my family and that helps, but sometimes, when I'm alone, I only listen to SVT 90% of the time. And I only care that they continue to be better and better, because their evolution has nothing to do with their popularity, although people believe that reflects their talent, for me, growth as a group and as a person is not to lose the values with those who started, independently of everything else and they do it. Each comeback is better, but they are still united and demonstrating with facts how much they take care of each other, like us their fans, we should do it with each other. I thank the life, to have known them and I hope that they continue to grow every day more and more.

text:
Multifandom I live for Kpop 

thanks! I’ll tell you a couple facts about the group and about the members!
So Wanna One was formed by the show Produce 101 Season 2. These 11 members were the top 11 chosen by the national producers. They debuted on August 7th under YMC Entertainment but switched to Swing Entertainment after their album 0+0=1 I Promise You. 
Yoon Jisung: His position is the Leader and Sub Vocalist. He’s the mother of the group and also the oldest. He’s from MMO Entertainment. He placed 8th place on Produce 101. He’s known as a meme lord because of his amazing facial expression XD and he also invented the Jisung clap.
Ha Sungwoon: His position is the Main Vocalist. He’s also a member of Hotshot!! He placed 11th on Produce 101. He from Star Crew Entertainment also known as Ador&Able. He is friends with BTS Jimin, EXO Kai, VIXX Ravi, SHINee Taemin, Ft. Island Hongki and etc. 
Hwang Minhyun: His position is a Lead Vocalist. He is a member of NU’EST. He is from Pledis Entertainment. His role in Wanna One is the “dad”. He placed 9th on Produce 101. His hobbies are cleaning and organizing and he’s also allergic to salt.
Ong Seongwoo: His position is a Main Dancer and a Lead Vocalist. He placed 5th on Produce 101. He’s from Fantagio Entertainment. He became known as the clapping slate before starting rehearsals. His role model is also EXO Kai.
Kim Jaehwan: His position is a Main Vocalist. He placed 4th on Produce 101. When he was on Produce 101, he was an independent trainee but after their debut, he signed with Stone Entertainment. He’s the messiest in the group and doesn’t like cleaning. He is also known for his almost maniacal laughter.
Kang Daniel: He placed 1st on Produce 101. His position is a Main Dancer, Lead Rapper, Sub Vocalist and the Center. He is from MMO Entertainment. He has been b-boxing since junior high school. He studied in Canada in the past and he’s also allergic to shellfish.
Park Jihoon: He placed 2nd and his positions are a Lead Dancer, Sub Vocalist, Sub Rapper and Visual. He’s known as Winky Boy and is also known for creating aegyo such as ‘heart unlock’. He was a child actor and is from Maroo Entertainment. 
Park Woojin: His position is a Main Rapper and Main Dancer. He placed 6th on Produce 101 and is from Brand New Music Entertainment. He received much love for his snaggletooth!! During Produce 101, he was hospitalized due to shingles disease. Also when he was 11 years old, he appeared on SuperstarK.
Bae Jinyoung: He ranked 10th and His position is a Sub Vocalist and a Visual. He’s from C9 Entertainment and he is considered to have one of the best visuals because of his small face. He’s also allergic to shrimps.
Lee Daehwi: He placed 3rd and his positions are a Lead Vocalist, Lead Dancer and Sub Rapper. He lived in America for 6 years and in Japan for 2 years. He’s known for the center of Nayana. He’s from Brand New Music Entertainment and used to be a former JYP trainee. He is friends with Somi from I.O.I and is also left handed. He is also skilled in writing lyrics and composing music. 
Lai Guanlin: He placed 7th and his position is Lead Rapper and Maknae. He is Taiwanese and lived in America. He’s from Cube Entertainment and his name means rainy season. He’s also close to Pentagon’s Wooseok.
That’s all the facts I’m gonna say for now! I’m sorry if it’s really long but feel free to write a lot of facts about Seventeen for me! I hope this helps you get to know Wanna One more! :)

author: @bronaghmccabe
text:
I would suggest 'One fine day 1' or 'Seventeen Project' but if you'd like something shorter their first few weekly idol episodes are a good intro. If you need subs check out https://www.like17subs.com/ a large majority of Seventeen subs are uploaded there. 

If you prefer learning names through guides and if you have the time the extremely detailed guides by okaykpop are really good
Vocal unit guide                https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAjYQk9c7rc
Performance unit guide   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EikbNvRz_NM
Hip hop unit guide            https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tFj3Xr_JX_M

If you prefer reading there's a really good power point but it hasn't been updated since don't wanna cry era (summer 2017) and it shows what each member looked like in each era before then.
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1WLfU14u0wB_OGklTLi2hUOeblp0bXcnOhS37ZLjj7Z8/edit#slide=id.p

If you prefer learning through music videos you can look up ''Seventeen ___________ labelled'' or ''Seventeen ___________ w/ names'' but they mostly cover earlier comebacks.

If you like After school club they have an episode https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m7TrCAEZbPw

The 'Ask in a box' video is good as it separates each member and they often refer to each other and their name is shown during their own segment. It also gives a small insight into different members roles and personalities https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DUWurmCLkI8

I hope any of the above comments will help you as it is quite daunting to suddenly learn 13 peoples names and personalities but you should take it at your own pace and it'll probably come to you easier than you think ^-^

author: @Orinoka666
text: Hello there! Seventeen debuted on 5/26/15. They're a 13-member group divided into 3 units: vocal unit (5 members), hip-hop unit (4 members), and performance unit (4 members). They're Seventeen because 13 members + 3 units + 1 team = 17. There's also BooSeokSoon (BSS) unit (the gag trio of Seventeen) and Seventeen leaders unit. They're called self-producing idols because they compose, produce, and write their songs. Woozi does most of the work but other members also participate in composing and writing lyrics, especially hip-hop unit. Performance unit creates choreographies. If you want to get to know them better I recommend starting with Seventeen Debut Project, One Fine Day, Seventeen on Weekly Idol, One Fine Day in Japan, SVT Club, Seventeen on Idol Room, and more.

S.Coups 1:32 (Nombre real, Choi Seungcheol) Líder de todo el grupo y de la unidad Hiphop. Es el papá del grupo.
Jeonhan 0:35 1:02 2:22 (Nombre completo, Yoon Jeonghan) Parte de la unidad vocal. Solía tener el cabello largo y es como la mamá del grupo.
Joshua 0:43 2:43 (Nombre real, Hong Jisoo)  Parte de la unidad vocal. Nació y vivía en L.A. hasta los 18 años cuando fue reclutado para ser parte de Seventeen. Sus papás son coreanos pero su lengua natal es el inglés.
Jun  0:58 1:57 (Nombre completo, Wen Jun Hui)  Parte de la unidad de presentación. Es uno de los miembros chinos.
Hoshi 1:09 2:55 (Nombre real, Kwon Soonyoung) Es el líder de la unidad de presentación. Es el coreografo principal del grupo (aunque creo que la coreografía de está canción en particular no la pudo hacer el ya que estaban demasiado ocupados con su debut en Japón).
Wonwoo 1:40 (Nombre completo, Jeon Wonwoo)  Es parte de la unidad de Hiphop. Es el que tiene la voz más profunda de todo el grupo.
Woozi 1:20 3:04 (Nombre real, Lee Jihoon) Es el líder de la unidad vocal. Es el productor y escritor principal de las canciones de Seventeen y es el más bajito del grupo.
The8 0:38 2:12 (Nombre real, Xu Ming Hao)  Es parte de la unidad de presentación. Es el segundo miembro chino y le gusta mucho el arte, incluso expuso algunas de sus pinturas junto con Mingyu.
Mingyu 0:32 1:06 1:51 (Nombre completo, Kim Mingyu)  Parte de la unidad de Hiphop. Es el miembro más alto de seventeen.
DK 0:29 2:17 3:09 (Nombre real, Lee Seokmin)  Parte de la unidad vocal. Es uno de los vocalistas principales de Seventeen. Es muy ruidoso y divertido.
Seungkwan 1:25 3:01 (Nombre completo, Boo Seungkwan)  Es parte de la unidad vocal y también es vocalista principal. Es el miembro más divertido en los shows de variedades y es el novio de Vernon~ (Osea no, pero los super shippeo xD)
Vernon 0:50 2:38 (Nombre real, Choi Hansol) Es parte de la unidad de Hiphop. Nació en Nueva York pero se mudó a corea cuando tenía como 5 años así que se considera culturalmente coreano. Madre americana, padre coreano. Habla muy bien el inglés.
Dino 2:01 (Nombre real, Lee Chan)  Es parte de la unidad de presentación y es el maknae del grupo. Es un gran fanboy de Michael Jackson el cual es su ejemplo a seguir.

author: @dianamontoya6895
text:
Good evening, Carats. I address especially to all those girls who have written in the SVT MV how much they like their songs and how much admiration they feel for them. I feel a very loyal and devoted fan of them. I can assure you, although you can also doubt it, that each time a new MV comes out, I repeat it again and again, to the point of exhaustion, to support them, but I see with sadness that not all of us do it.
The group is great, the guys are handsome and work like slaves, but even so, we never achieve the goals as we expect.
The only reason I can think of, eliminating my suspicion that the views are bought, is that we are a fandom that does not commit.
Then, we must accept that they will never be what we expect and deserve to be, they will never reach truly international levels, much less, they will be able to compete with other groups that, without so much talent, are much more popular.
I just want to express my opinion, without attacking anyone, so we do not miss what happens, for example, they have not obtained the fourth prize.
Let's continue like this, then, with a group that stayed halfway, that we will continue supporting, but that will never be really supported by its fandom.

author: @lindaschlutsmeier5323
text: Well Seventeen debuted May 26 in 2015 under Pledis Entertainment. They are 13 boys: S.Coups, Jeonghan, Joshua, Jun, Hoshi, Wonwoo, Woozi, The8, Mingyu, DK,  Seungkwan, Vernon, Dino. They are divided into three units: Vocal, HipHop + Performance. Seventeen is a self producing idol group, that means they write, compose, produce their own songs and make the choreography. Woozi is the main producer and Hoshi the main choreographer. This are their eras so far: Adore U, Mansae, Pretty U, Very Nice, BoomBoom, Don't Wanna Cry, Clap, Thanks, Oh My. Their fandom name is carat and their colours are serenity and rose quartz. Carats are a really friendly and supportive fandom, you will see. To get to know them better I recommend you their MVs, Guided to Seventeen, Seventeen Project, Seventeen One Fine Day and other shows. text:
Chanyeol’sBigEars ChanBaek 
Variety shows are pretty useful, plus they're entertaining to watch. Some suggestions to get you started:
17 project - shows how the achieved a live debut stage, also shows how they write, produce and choreograph their performances.
Weekly idol - just fun, shows a lot of their hidden talents.
Idol room - similar concept to Weekly idol (former hosts/staff of Weekly idol have moved to this show)
One fine day:
Season 1 - bonding in a bad situation.
Season 2 - older members competing against the younger members.
Going Seventeen (and going seventeen spin-off) - sort of a behind the scenes look into their lives.
SVT club - discussion of popular terms, and how the members relate to them.

author: @cchoi831
text:
Came back here after re-watching SEVENTEEN Project, and this song seems even more special than before. What non-CARATs see is a 3-minute song, but what they don't see are the years of hard work, the tears, the insecurities, and the breakdowns that SEVENTEEN had to endure to just set foot on stage. These 13 boys worked their asses off just to debut, and through their hardships they continued to carry their aspiration to become an "artist" - not just a "singer". And that's what they've become. 

SEVENTEEN is beyond comparable when it comes to music production, choreography, and lyricism. If you listen to a SEVENTEEN song, you can't categorize it into any genre other than 'SEVENTEEN.' When you see SEVENTEEN choreography, it's not like any other dance you've seen before.

I guess what I want to say is THANK YOU, my sebongies. Thank you for sleeping 1-2 hours a day to produce such masterpieces with every comeback. Thank you for not giving up throughout those years of uncertainty. Thank you for the friendship and teamwork that makes SEVENTEEN so lovable. Thank you for your humbleness. Thank you for loving us, your CARATs. Thank you - so, so much - for being SEVENTEEN.

text:
*What to do if you want YouTube to count your views:*
1. LOG OUT of your account.
2. DISABLE adblock.
3. DO NOT use playlists. Turn off autoplay.
4. Watch the mv in at least 720p and set the youtube volume on at least 50% (you can change it on your device tho).
5. DO NOT skip ads.
6. DO NOT use multiple tabs or windows. Use different browsers instead.
7. After watching the mv clear cache, browser cookies etc (I use CCleaner and I recommend it)
8. Manually search for the mv again (it also helps Seventeen to be higher on the youtube searching list)
9. It's advised to watch other mv's from time to time.
10. DO NOT use hashtags when you comment, it freezes the views.

text:
Here's a streaming guideline I got from a post on Tumblr (my-woozi-happiness) so Youtube doesn't delete anymore of our views!

 Please dont forget to tell carats how to stream properly as well. The most highly recommended way is to follow the steps down below:

1. Logout of account 

2. Manually search for mv by using the search bar 

3. For the sake of receiving the special videos, please refrain from streaming the mv on 1thek for now and watch the mv on seventeen’s official page. 

4. Watch the ad all the way through. Please do not skip the ad for it will not count as a view. 

5. Watch the mv in hd with minimum volume at 50% 

6. Watch the mv from start to finish. Please do not skip, pause, or speed up the mv or else it will not count. 

7. Once the mv is finished open a new tab and repeat steps 2-6. Please clear out your history every 30 mins. 

Please do not refresh or replay as it will only count as one view. 

***note: this step is also a good time to watch other music vides by svt. However please be aware that creating a playlist to stream will not count!!! It is very important to remember this!! 

** also note: watching the mv with multiple web browsers (such as chrome, firefox, explorer, and safari) at the same time is fine but watching the mv with multiple tabs is NOT OK! 

Please watch the mv first and then when it is over, open a new tab. Also, please bring positive words to this mv. 

We cannot discourage each other from streaming. Refrain from using negative comments and please report anyone who do so. 

Streaming is not an easy thing to do and it can be quite frustrating sometimes but We are doing this because we love seventeen, and we are paying them back for all the hard work that they have done.

I don't know if-I'm right or not...but each music show-counts the views,album sales,digital's each week,and those YouTube views for that week,don't get included into the next week scoring...

so what I'm saying is if they get 7 million views this week-it will only count for next week score and then the score for the mv-will be set back to zero and whatever views we get from the following week,will go towards next weeks score.

it's the same as album scores...whatever albums sold during this week,will only count for next week {music show's) only...after that it starts over again and whatever albums sale the following week,will be counted in the following week score 


So that's why we should be on our game each week and stream hard-bc they only count the mv views for that week only-so say we only got 200,000 views that week,that's what will go towards the Score-not 7.7 million...so plz stream-if you want them to have a chance,after next week

author: @saeyoung9824
text:
HOW TO STREAM CORRECTLY SO YOUR VIEW WILL BE COUNTED
***DO NOT STREAM ON YT APP. 

1. Logout of account 
2. Manually search for mv by using the search bar 
3. For the sake of receiving the special videos, please refrain from streaming the mv on 1thek for now and watch the mv on seventeen’s official page. 
4. Watch the ad all the way through. Please do not skip the ad for it will not count as a view. 
5. Watch the mv in hd with minimum volume at 50% 
6. Watch the mv from start to finish. Please do not skip, pause, or speed up the mv or else it will not count. 
7. Once the mv is finished open a new tab and repeat steps 2-6. Please clear out your history every 30 mins. 
Please do not refresh or replay as it will only count as one view. 
***note: this step is also a good time to watch other music vides by svt. However please be aware that creating a playlist to stream will not count!!! It is very important to remember this!! 
** also note: watching the mv with multiple web browsers (such as chrome, firefox, explorer, and safari) at the same time is fine but watching the mv with multiple tabs is NOT OK! 
Please watch the mv first and then when it is over, open a new tab.

author: @valerieinto
text:
For you streaming carats, here's a thing that happened with me and this video a couple days ago.

I'm in Toronto, and a friend of mine in Leeds UK was on Twitter helping out a fellow friend with anxiety (which we all have, though we first connected about different stuff). UK friend said she understood not being able to use all her coping tactics when things got tough, because she was going through a difficult work thing. So I ducked into DMs to ask her what was up. She said explaining it would just make her angry and sad, so she asked me how things were going with me. Not wanting to push, I told her about various things going on good and not-great, and I added, "Also of course happy cute group I like put out new happy cute music with happy cute dancing. ❤️" I'm kind of the kpop stan in my friend groups, so I make glancing references to it sometimes without going nuts, and had linked to this video on Twitter a couple days prior. My friend asked, "Not watched that yet, was that the punk group?" 😂I had also linked to the new Pussy Riot video earlier, which was indeed happy and cute but in a whole other way. 😂😂😂I said no, explaining, then linked to her this video. 

Now, when I do that, I don't expect people to give reviews or anything - I just figured we'd go on with our conversation and she'd ask me about other stuff going on. I just threw it out there because why not, couldn't hurt, watch it or not, maybe go back to it later. Several minutes passed, then she replied starting with "Now you've got me in a positive place, I'll explain...." and goes on to talk to me about the trouble she'd been having. We went back and forth picking it apart, looked at some options, and later she thanked me for giving her the chance to offload and help her figure things out and prepare for what's to come. Then she said, "Have checked out Seventeen on YouTube... now off to add to Spotify xx" 😊❤️

So there you go. Power of Seventeen. Keep fighting.

text:
Hi Carats!!! We are hosting a mass streaming for this mv starting on Sunday (07.22) and Monday (07.23😊)at 12am kst for both days. You can stream whenever time is most convenient for you for those 2 days. If you missed the first day, please join us on the second day 😊

The goal for Sunday is 10M and the goal for Monday is 17M! Please spread the word through social media to get more Carats to join us!

Please dont forget to tell carats how to stream properly as well. The most highly recommended way is to follow the steps down below:
1. Logout of account
2. Manually search for mv by using the search bar
3. For the sake of receiving the special videos, please refrain from streaming the mv on 1thek for now and watch the mv on seventeen’s official page.
4. Watch the ad all the way through. Please do not skip the ad for it will not count as a view.
5. Watch the mv in hd with minimum volume at 50%
6. Watch the mv from start to finish. Please do not skip, pause, or speed up the mv or else it will not count.
7. Once the mv is finished open a new tab and repeat steps 2-6. Please clear out your history every 30 mins. Please do not refresh or replay as it will only count as one view.
***note: this step is also a good time to watch other music vides by svt. However please be aware that creating a playlist to stream will not count!!! It is very important to remember this!!
**** also note: watching the mv with multiple web browsers (such as chrome, firefox, explorer, and safari) at the same time is fine but watching the mv with multiple tabs is NOT OK! Please watch the mv first and then when it is over, open a new tab.

Also, please bring positive words to this mv. We cannot discourage each other from streaming. Refrain from using negative comments and please report anyone who do so. Streaming is not an easy thing to do and it can be quite frustrating sometimes but We are doing this because we love seventeen, and we are paying them back for all the hard work that they have done.
My motivation for this is to see Seventeen get their first win! I am a baby carat so I didnt get a chance to experience that with them but with this song, we can totally do it!

I know it is kinda last minute but We can make our goal together! Let’s do it for our boys and let’s work hard. If I am missing anything please comment down below ❤️

text:
Svt Carat 1. You need to log out of your account. 
2. You have to search this mv and play it on seventeen’s official page (pledis wont combine views from 1theK) 
3. Watch the ad. Please dont skip it or it wont count as a view
4.make sure the mv is in hd with full volume (i use headphones so I dont get tired of the songs easily)
5. Watch the mv from start to finish. Dont add it to a playlist and dont hit the refresh/replay button because doing that will make it count as a spam.
6. Open a new tab and repeat steps 2-5. Make sure you delete your history everyone in awhile. 

Tip: watching the mv in multiple tabs will cause it to spam BUT watching it in multiple browsers (like chrome and firefox) is ok. Dont watch the mv in private mode. 

Ps: make sure you have something to motivate you when streaming gets tough. 

Happy Streaming and I hope this helps

❤️❤️ STREAMING GUIDE ❤️❤️
(from @WorldwideCarats)

1. Search for the official MV on SEVENTEEN Channel
2. Watch the MV till the end.
3. Clear cookies/history/cache.
4. Repeat Steps 1-3
5. Keep the volume over 50% and play in HD - 720P

❤️ T I P S ❤️
1. Log-in to Like/Comment/Subscribe
2. Log-out to STREAM
3. Share on SNS (FB, Twitter, IG, KKT, etc.)

❤️ D O N ' T ❤️
1. Don't use PLAYLIST
2. Don't speed up or skip the MV
3. Don't use any app to increase the views
4. Don't click the REPLAY BUTTON to stream (REFRESH the page)

❤️ N O T I C E ❤️
The views will freeze when YouTube validates them to remove SPAM and FAKE VIEWS, so DON'T PANIC IF THE NUMBERS ARE STUCK.

Thank you and happy streaming!

author: @전원우-f9g
text:
I love how there is such HUGE GAP between the likes and dislikes in SVT's MVs. It's roughly 99.6% likes for this. While it's 98.5% for DWC which has more than a million likes already.

I think people are still sleeping on SVT not because they don't like their songs, it's probably because SVT's music is unique - and the public is probably much more used to typical beats most popular songs tend to have. Yet, that's not how SVT works. They like to experiment a lot (I'm thankful they have that freedom given they're self-producing idols) yet they always manage to keep the "SVT vibes" in all of their songs. 

Also, I think quite a lot of people don't care about the lyrics esp if they're not Korean, which is sad because you guys are missing out on SVT's beautiful lyrics. They don't know that every component of SVT's performances - song, dance, lyrics (even the MV) - are meaningfully intertwined. The choreographies and sync are no joke either - they're very successful in using their numbers despite people assuming that it would be a mess with 13 members. Well, they were also in sync in making a mistake... :D

This is why I still think that SVT's ironically famous yet underrated. Of course, there are other factors, aside from what I mentioned, like coming from an unpopular company (Like c'mon, people also slept on Pristin V's "Get It" WHICH IS SUCH A BOP). 

Despite this, I am thankful that the fandom, us Carats, are great. 

My friend suggested SVT to me, Wonwoo made me stay, and I'm grateful I've come to like this group since I was hibernating from KPOP before I became a Carat.

Fighting! <3

author: @spicyaznsauce3139
text: From what I see around the fandom, many CARATs are multifandom so there's that lower tendency to stream or vote for them in a way. I'm slightly multifandom myself, but my main group is SEVENTEEN. As for SEVENTEEN's popularity in Korea, I'm not too sure about it. From an international fan perspective, there was an acronym called EBS which stood for EXO, BTS, and SEVENTEEN. I don't really know where SEVENTEEN stands in Korea in terms of popularity. I know EXO has a big fandom and has public appeal. BTS is gaining attention for their international impact and growing international attention as well. As for SEVENTEEN, they are quietly growing. Seungkwan is a regular at a variety show, Mingyu is a weekly host at a music show, and they recently did an OST on a webdrama called ATeen. I do hope to come to a point where the general public shows favor to them, but if it does happen or not, I'll still support them.

author: @junxiuyu9229
text: I become a fan of seventeen not because they are super popular or No.1 in the industry. I stan them because they are talented and get the whole package. They are humble yet ambitious, which is really rare to see in the industry based on my own observation. In some people's eyes, they may not be that famous/popular, but indeed, they are actually not that non-popular, if you check their sales, peak ranks, etc. Data never lies. They are progressing slowly but steadily. And the fandom becomes strong this time. It turns out at least for the first day of come back, way more better than last time. I've witnessed both on twitter and weibo (sns in China), how carats volunteered to organize fans to stream, sacrificing their own time. And how fans have been united to contribute whatever they can. I've never streamed before. And tbh, I still not believe this is the way to prove how good a song is. But since right now, it becomes a hard index to measure, I am here to streaming to support them and make them shine, because I know they deserve what I've been done for them.

i don’t know if everybody know this yet, but i’ll state it again for everyone

1. do not repeat, do not fast forward - watch the full thing
2. watch it in 480p or up, 50% youtube volume or up
3. do not log in youtube while you’re streaming, otherwise it gets 1 view
4. (if you are using pc like me) open ONLY 1 youtube tab in every internet browser
5. basically copy the link of the mv > open and watch it > open new tab + delete old tab > paste in the link + watch again
6. after about 10 times in every browsers, delete the history and repeat

that’s how you get the most views

author: @moonipie
text:
the first one to sing is DK, he's a real sunshine! (0:29)
second one is Mingyu, he's the tallest Member of the group (0:31)
the one with beautiful red hair is Jeonghan, he's such a prince. (and he used to have long hair!) (0:34) 
after him, there is The8. He's one of the best dancers amongst them and a sometimes a savage cutipie (0:37)
Joshua starts to sing at 0:43 and is one of the two members that speak english fluently
speaking of English, Vernon's part is right after him (0:47) and as you can see, he's such a visual as well :D
Jun starts singing at 0:58 and he's the second half of the china-line (the8 is the other half)
then, after Jeonghan and Mingyu again, Hoshi's part starts at 1:08. He's the main dancer and choreographer.
the angel you see at 1:20 is woozi, the (this time) white haired genius producer. (go watch CALL CALL CALL if you want to get slayed :D)
Seungkwan (he's sometimes a little sassy) sits at the end of the table at 1:24 , he's a very stable vocalist and effortlessly hits almost every high note (as well as DK)
S.Coups part starts at 1:32 he's the leader of the Group and the Hip Hop Team
1:40 - Wonwoo is the handsome one in the car. He has a very deep voice, but also sings from time to time, like Mingyu, whose part starts right after.
and last but not least, Dino, our Maknae, gets his part at 2:01, after Jun. 

I hope this helped and you enjoyed the video! <3 :)
